propositions: Code snapshot entries in materialize() populate branch write every blob fresh without hardlinking or delta against adjacent entries, causing 4.00x write amplification for successive single-file commits
The delta_tree.py generic hardlink-clone helper from bug 8386 can be wired into the code materialization path to enable unchanged blob reuse with minimal blast radius

Sharing storage between adjacent code snapshots must not weaken the attestation basis that store/<sha> is the authentic tree at <sha>, and must maintain byte-match fidelity for LFS pointers and submodule sidecars

The code tree is significantly smaller and less critical than the ticket store for reuse, but HEAD-ref workflows with per-commit key movement create a fast-moving regime where sharing is observably beneficial
